comment: files.c fopen_wizkit_file() with WIZKIT=/.nethackrc: the root directory holds no such entry, so access() fails with ENOENT and C reports "Access to /.nethackrc denied (2)."; it then opens "$HOME//.nethackrc", the configuration file itself, and read_wizkit() wishes for its two item lines (which initoptions() first reported as "Not a config statement"). Seed, date, Samurai and items chosen independently.

segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:Quill,role:Samurai,race:human,gender:female,align:lawful,playmode:debug,!legacy,!tutorial,!splash_screen,pettype:none,!autopickup
WIZKIT=/.nethackrc
# kit items
3 cursed scrolls of teleportation
blessed +1 elven dagger
